dedupe_keys.name: the effect of single reservoir stabilization on colorado river simulation system crss outputs under various hydrology scenarios

description: The Effect of Single Reservoir Stabilization on Colorado River Simulation System (CRSS) Outputs Under Various Hydrology Scenarios is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Williams, Bryan (deposited on HydroShare). This study evaluates the effects of a single-reservoir stabilization alternative on performance metrics within the Colorado River Simulation System (CRSS), such as outflows from Lake Powell and Lake Mead, water elevations, and storage. The experimental alternative focuses on stabilizing water elevation in Lake Powell while maintaining a minimum protection elevation in Lake Mead. Coverage: Colorado, United States. The resource was created 2026-04-26 and last updated 2026-07-22; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
